brief.headline: Fix the 40% return problem first, then push price toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc and tighten payment to 15 days

priceAsk.summary: Ask for price in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range for the 28 mm cap at higher volume
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows the open asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — our target sits in that better band

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Tightening to 15 days frees up ₹6817 in cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Scorpion publishes no financial statements, so we cannot see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. Our ₹1.66 L annual spend is tiny — we have almost no revenue weight with them. That means we lean on having real backup sources lined up and on fixing the quality mess (40% returns) before we can push hard on price or terms.

evidence.point: Four out of every ten items they deliver get sent back
We spend only ₹1.66 L a year with them
Current terms are 30 days after receipt
Market asking price for 28 mm PP cap typically runs ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room to ₹0.65–0.80 at scale
We have no visibility into Scorpion's finances — they do not publish accounts

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100) — makes pharma bottles, caps and preforms; top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health score 73/100) covering pails, containers and pharma packaging — strong and profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — manufacturer with pan-India reach; confidence medium

risks: The 40% return rate is bleeding money and time — unless root-cause (quality, spec mismatch, paperwork) is fixed, any price or term win will be eaten by rework and delays
Our ₹1.66 L spend gives us almost zero leverage — Scorpion can walk away easily, so line up Manjushree or Mold-Tek and get a live quote before pushing hard
No published financials means we fly blind on their stability — if they fold or stop supplying, we have no early warning
Market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads only — none are qualified or priced yet, so do not treat them as live alternates until audited
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to keep working together, but four out of every ten pieces you send come back — let's fix that first, then talk about getting your price into the ₹0.65–0.80 range the market supports and tightening payment to 15 days.
